Name: Megumi's Barn Foxes (Classic)
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[center][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/7pjG4oV.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───
This mod adds foxes to Marnie's shop! It's not a replacement mod, it actually adds them in!
I have 35 shades of the Red Fox along with Sand, Arctic, and Fennec foxes!
They will harvest truffles for you and when they trust you enough, they may even dig up their treasures for you that they snatched from around town! But keep an eye out for sneaky Tanuki that might try to use their disguise magic to sneak in and steal your fox's truffles!

Bonus: A few of my OC D&D characters are available as foxes!
This is just for me but I hope you enjoy their designs too! 
Bonus foxes: Megumi, Evoeri, Yaeko, Kyouki, Princess, and twins Nakaria and Zakaria. I included character details so you know the inspirations behind the treasures they find and bring to you. 
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───
Compatible with 1.6
Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
I am very VERY new to this, this is my very first mod and my first time coding since Myspace days lol.
I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pN61w0v.png[/img]﻿

Current Version 2.2.1

This version of the foxes won't be updated with new content in the future but I will always make sure it works!

[b]2.2.1: [/b]Fixed a error the Suspicious Fox was causing in Daily Task log. 
[b]2.2.0: [/b]Removed a item could not be picked up and causing issues.

7 different fox sounds have been added.  [/size] 
The mischievous twins Nakaria and Zakaria have been added along with their own special barks!
[size=4]Adjusted Princess' treasures that were the wrong ID and she should bring you the right items now!

[b]2.0.1:[/b] Fixed the image asset for Fawn Glow foxes that stayed as kits and didn't switch to adult versions.

[b]2.0.0: [/b]Adjusted an Item ID bug.

─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Planned Updates
New treasures the common foxes will bring. (Ex. Fruit, Eggs, ect)
Bat Ear, Crab-Eating, Sechuran, Grey, and Island foxes. Possibly Maned fox in the future too.
Make item IDs from Animal Husbandry, HxW, and Cornucopia treasures all the foxes can bring.
